decisions.reason: As a full line presented on its own page, the aloe vera facial care range represents a visible, larger investment and public commitment, so management would persist and attribute any early weakness to the launch phase.

The hyaluronic serum is only mentioned, so little has been publicly committed, but it fits the core facial care offer and costs little to keep in small-batch production, and there is no evidence of failure.
The cleansing milk is a staple close to the established range with low incremental investment, and without results that rule out temporary causes, management has no pressing reason to withdraw it.
